hints: Find the $x^1$ and $x^2$ terms in the expansion of $(x+4)^5 = (4+x)^5$.
Identify the combinations when multiplying by $(2-3x)$ that produce $x^2$: $(x^2 \text{ term}) \times 2$ and $(x^1 \text{ term}) \times (-3x)$.
Compute $640(2) + 1280(-3)$ to determine the total coefficient.
walkthrough:
Determine the relevant terms in the binomial expansion of $(4+x)^5$:
$$\text{Term in } x: \quad \binom{5}{1}(4)^4(x)^1 = 5 \times 256 \times x = 1280x$$
$$\text{Term in } x^2: \quad \binom{5}{2}(4)^3(x)^2 = 10 \times 64 \times x^2 = 640x^2$$

Identify the terms producing $x^2$ when $(x+4)^5$ is multiplied by $(2-3x)$:
$$\text{From } (640x^2)(2) = 1280x^2$$
$$\text{From } (1280x)(-3x) = -3840x^2$$

Sum the components to find the total coefficient of $x^2$:
$$\text{Coefficient of } x^2 = 1280 - 3840 = -2560$$
